title: Loop answer predicate
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean input string, let $c$ be a configuration of $W$ on input $x$, and let $v$ be a natural number. The loop answer is true exactly when running $W$ from $c$ for $v$ steps does not both halt and produce the one-symbol output string consisting of true.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$c$ is a configuration of $W$ on input $x$
